title: Unique sound system documented: Ma Manda Phonology
text: Such is the case with Ma Manda, a language spoken by a community of 1,500 people in the Finisterre Mountains of Morobe Province, Papua New Guinea. In Ma Manda Phonology, a new SIL e-Book, SIL linguist Ryan Pennington describes a feature of Ma Manda's sound system that may well be unique among known languages.
